elements.description: Grouped filters: removable chips on top, collapsible groups of checkboxes below.

properties.name: groups
properties.description: The filter groups, in order – each a collapsible list of options that become chips when picked

properties.name: value
properties.description: The picked options, per group id

properties.name: open
properties.description: Ids of the open groups – unset opens the first group

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name for native form submission: one hidden input per picked option, named `name[groupId]`

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Nothing can be picked, removed or cleared, and the hidden inputs are left out of the form

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, next to Clear all

properties.name: hints
properties.description: Show the keyboard hints at the bottom (Clean: as the last row of the card); hints="false" hides them

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: An option is picked or removed, or all are cleared; detail `{ value: FilterValue }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A group opens or folds; detail `{ open: string[] }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `open`

props.name: groups
props.description: The filter groups, in order – each a collapsible list of options that become chips when picked

props.name: value
props.description: The picked options. Controlled when defined; otherwise the menu keeps its own, starting at `defaultValue`

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value whenever an option is picked or removed, or all are cleared

props.name: open
props.description: Ids of the open groups. Controlled when defined; otherwise starts at `defaultOpen`

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Groups that start open – by default the first one

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the ids of the open groups whenever a group opens or folds

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, next to Clear all – "Filters" by default

changelog: filter-menu renders only the rows near the viewport in groups over 60 options (tested with 5,000).
